g.text: Superfluid illustration: assume ALL unbound neutrons are paired. Lattice = baryons bound in nuclear clusters.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #455263

g.text: Bound neutrons count as neutrons AND as part of the lattice. Electrons and muons carry no baryon number and are excluded from these percentages.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #455263

g.text: Pairing gaps, temperature and entrainment are not solved. BSk24 composition example; this is a separate model from the workspace's APR star.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #66717e

g.text: Source: Pearson et al. (2018, 2019), CompOSE PCP(BSK24), Zenodo 14509138. Surface at the lowest tabulated pressure; transitions located within table brackets.
